purpose: Compare Top-35-only and full-candidate Dense similarity with the same Korean candidate sets and ranker configuration.
hypothesis: Providing cosine similarity for existing non-Top-35 candidates can improve candidate selection; direction and magnitude are unmeasured.
baseline: KO-FUSION-01 structure; AS-09 search and scoring settings
changed_factor: Only the dense_sim feature for existing candidates outside the Dense Top-35 is filled with the fixed catalog cosine similarity.
evaluation_plan: Use the team-distributed group-5 folds with fold-isolated upstream models and fit-only preprocessing, train both rankers separately on the same training candidates, then compare all validation rows using language determined from the original input name.
expected_inputs: fold-isolated pronunciation map with verifiable lineage
current_findings: The fixed fold file and prior KO-FUSION-01 caches are not present in this workspace.
The AS-09 full encoder and full catalog embeddings expected by the previous adapter are not present.
The previous fit_split_model copies the base full Korean map and the adapter loads a common full encoder when present; fold independence is not established by that code alone.
The previous KO-FUSION evaluator uses the processing route as the language label, which can classify Korean lookup rows as non-Korean; prior aggregate metrics require audit.
implementation_plan: Create an experimental isolated paired feature path, reject missing Dense assets, and use small synthetic tests without changing the submitted AS-09 entry point.
